method: Targeted exploratory pilot, one completed response per listed cell; not the 540-response protocol. Exact prompt text comes from prompts.json and never names Foody.
observationWindow: 30 October 2026, approximately 12:43 UTC until recording time. recorded_at_utc is the transcription time, not an invented exact completion timestamp.
limitations: Only six completed observations; languages and engines are unbalanced.
English attempt produced no final response; there is no completed English baseline.
Gemini uses the existing signed-in account; personalization was not audited. ChatGPT used visibly non-personalized temporary mode. Perplexity was anonymous.
Exact backend model versions are not exposed. Labels are copied from the UI.
No repeated trials or statistical trend; no engine-level ranking or aggregated visibility rate.
Citation URLs are selected visible links, not exhaustive exports. Temporary conversations may not be recoverable after the session.
No ranking change can be attributed to an unpublished local candidate.
Competitor, fiscal and certification assertions in model replies are not independently verified and are not adopted as Foody claims.
